summary: Plan LMS requirements, review SCORM and LTI workflows, and improve learning evidence. Explore the course and its practical outcomes.
lede: Learning management systems training helps teams assess platform needs and improve learner journeys and reporting. It is for LMS coordinators, learning designers and training leads who need to turn operational needs into requirements, check SCORM content and accessibility, and map LTI or xAPI data flows. Participants also review learning indicators and use findings to shape a prioritised service-improvement roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make learning platforms useful, measurable and workable across training teams. It suits people who contribute to LMS decisions or delivery and want practical methods for connecting platform needs with learner experience and reporting.
modules: LMS Service Needs and User Journeys
prerequisites: Working familiarity with digital training delivery, learning operations or online course administration is useful. No specific LMS vendor or programming background is assumed; technical integration and analytics topics are covered at an operational overview level.
